title: Sepher Yetzirah
author: W. Wynn Westcott (trans)
description: The Book of Formation in W. Wynn Westcott's translation presents a compact account of creation through letters, numbers and the sefirot. It became a foundational text for later Jewish mystical and esoteric interpretation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/sepheryetzirahb00rittgoog).
